method: authored side/rear axis guide, then local forearm reconstruction
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: King full REAR with the new jet and two ivory tanks. Image 2 is an AUTHOR-DRAWN GEOMETRY GUIDE for the anatomical RIGHT ARM ONLY, not art style. Image 3 user red circle locates the wrong assembly; no annotations appear in output.
FIX ONLY the right elbow/forearm/drill installation, viewer RIGHT. The previous attempt failed because a golden cone STILL sticks out underneath the black rear cap. Do not repeat this.
Set the right elbow slightly bent FORWARD so that the entire forearm and drill assembly share a common axis pointing to the ROBOT'S FRONT, directly AWAY from rear camera, with only a slight 5–10 degree downward pitch as in guide Image 2. The visible rear casing/collar is NEAREST camera. The drill cone extends on the FAR side of that casing, fully OCCLUDED from this rear view. There is ABSOLUTELY NO golden triangular cone, point, spiral or taper visible below, to the right or around this arm's rear cap. Remove the current gold pointed triangle completely and fill that area with clean white background. Do NOT reattach a short mini-drill at the bottom.
Rebuild the visible right forearm as the coherent back of the same navy/gold segmented gauntlet: round dark rear-end drive casing with gold support ring on the near rear face, navy armor and gold bands connected to the existing ivory upper arm/elbow. Because forearm is angled forward into depth, it is naturally FORESHORTENED in rear projection, rather than a long down-right sleeve with a point. Keep the right shoulder and upper arm attached in their current locations. A compact gold pivot/housing and gold rim are fine, but no cone geometry on near/back side. The cone itself still exists FORWARD, hidden behind the casing; this is occlusion, not deleting the weapon.
Everything outside this one right elbow/forearm assembly remains EXACTLY as Image 1: same tall body and long thighs/shins, same three-small-engine wing roots, two rectangular cannon breeches, wing blades, left shield interior, main central black/red jet, TWO ivory cylindrical fuel tanks, two original lower long booster nacelles, crown/fin, heels, all panel colors and white canvas. Do not shorten, widen or redesign robot. No text, arrows, circle marks, captions or extra panels. One clean whole-body REAR drawing.
